scripts.dev:camera: npm run prepare:cert && MOCK_HTTPS=true npm-run-all -p task:camera task:mock
scripts.prepare:cert: mkdir -p certificates && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certificates/local-key.pem -out certificates/local-cert.pem -days 365 -subj '/CN=192.168.0.6.nip.io' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:192.168.0.6.nip.io,IP:192.168.0.6,DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1' -quiet
scripts.task:camera: mkdir -p certificates && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certificates/local-key.pem -out certificates/local-cert.pem -days 365 -subj '/CN=192.168.0.6.nip.io' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:192.168.0.6.nip.io,IP:192.168.0.6,DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1' -quiet && next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --experimental-https --experimental-https-key certificates/local-key.pem --experimental-https-cert certificates/local-cert.pem
